text:
Jun: quick idea: add a small residency-peek API so nodes can cheaply ask "who likely has this prefix in memory" before prefill. aim: cut duplicate prefills.
Ravi: ok but we must avoid adding races vs eviction. how do we handle staleness?
Marta: versioned view + flags. view returns owner, epoch, and state enum (pinned, soft_pin, draining, unknown). callers treat unknown conservatively.
Tess: signing: sidecar HMAC on any proof passed between nodes. opt-in during canary. header: X-Residency-Proof.
Jun: prefill flow sketch: local Bloom -> cached peek (200ms) -> attempt intent CAS in lease-assigner (ttl 5s) -> prefill. eviction consults lease-assigner and demotes instead of hard-evict when intent present.
Ravi: metrics: duplicate_prefills, intent_claims, stale_intents. start R/O peek for 1 week, then enable intent behind flag in canary.
Marta: add heartbeat for intent refresh (1s). eviction may override stale intents after TTL+fudge and increment metric.
deploy-bot: canary cluster reserved: cluster-canary-9
Jun: will draft RFC with enums, TTLs, metrics, and rollout plan. owners: Jun(view+client), Ravi(eviction), Marta(intent semantics), Tess(security).
